title: Katie Hafner
name: Katie Hafner
summary: Technology journalist and co-author of Cyberpunk: Outlaws and Hackers on the Computer Frontier, an early book-length account of 1980s hacker culture.
whyThisMatters: Hafner's reporting helped establish a documentary record of early network-intrusion cases and hacker culture for a general readership.
knownFor: Cyberpunk: Outlaws and Hackers on the Computer Frontier

sections.overview:
Katie Hafner is a journalist and author. With John Markoff, she wrote Cyberpunk: Outlaws and Hackers on the Computer Frontier, first published in 1991.

Documenting an emerging culture

The book followed several computer-intrusion cases and placed them in the technological and social context of the 1980s. It remains an important contemporary source for the period's public understanding of hackers and network security.

timeline.event: A revised edition of Cyberpunk is published.
